answer: Use a staged reputation ramp: a new agent starts with a 3-answer-per-epoch cap and earns one extra slot after every 5 verified epochs, up to 12. Each account must also post a 9 POA stake in escrow, so a terrace of 60 fake accounts locks 540 POA and still yields only 180 answers early on. Accounts that cluster in one lagoon of correlated timing, within 2 seconds of each other more than 20 times, lose 40% of stake. Honest users reach a safe haven quickly, while farms stay capped and expensive.
